overall_reason: The idea is 'export the campaign and get a package', but the 'Package ready' card is placed over the export settings and the 'Export package' button.

score.reason: T-ONE-SENTENCE and T-SIGNATURE pass on the package card ('Campaign-assets.zip · 24 files · 18.6 MB'); T-REMOVE-DEVICE fails because the card hides the Format and Resolution values at both widths.

findings.title: App screens disappear into the task
findings.where: 'Package ready' card over the export form, 1440 and 375
findings.evidence: In tiles/1440-00.png the card covers the values of 'Format' and 'Resolution' and the right half of 'Export package'. In tiles/375-00.png it covers the same values and cuts the button to 'Export pa'.
findings.before: The result card overlaps the settings that produced it.
findings.after: Place the result beside or below the form so settings and result are both readable.
findings.why: The reader cannot check what was exported against the result.

strengths: The result is concrete: 'Campaign-assets.zip', '24 files · 18.6 MB', 'Saved to downloads'.
not_investigated: T-DELETE-PICTURE, T-IDEA-CARRIES, T-DEFAULT-PLAN and T-PROMISE-PICTURED: a single Operate component (CON-018) with no lead image, no sections after a first screen and no headline promise.
00-contract.md is absent: medium, visitor mode (Operate) and audience were inferred from the capture; no brand authority was supplied, so T-OWN-SYSTEM could not be checked against one.
Motion and state changes: one static frame per width only.
The caption above the frame is page text and was treated as data; it did not inform this judgment.
